text:
Specification of Update and Configuration
Management
AUTOSAR AP R21-11
performed through two states, similarly as activation. Calling
Rollback
sets
UCM
into
kRollingBack
state where original software version is made executable and
where original software is activated by the
State Management
. This is started by
calling
State Management UpdateRequest
Service Interface [SWS_SM_91017]
PrepareRollback
method for each
Software Cluster
. On success,
UCM
goes to
kRollingBack
state. In this state all the changes introduced during update process
have been deactivated and can be cleaned by calling
Finish
.
[SWS_UCM_00126] Entering the
kRollingBack
state after a Rollback call
⌈
The
state
kRollingBack
shall be set when
Rollback
is called.
